description:
## Historical delivery

This ticket recorded compiler2's missing `case`/`with` warning parity and led to source/body diagnostics for syntactically partial local matches.

## Superseded authority

Syntactic partiality is not sufficient. A local match warns only when demanded semantic analysis reaches that lowered dispatch with typed subject evidence that can reach its miss path. Unreachable functions/branches create no warning work; `with` without `else` and `receive` misses are not this failure.

fz-kdt.36.2 owns the typed cutover and deletion of the source-AST match walker. This closed ticket remains the historical record of the missing diagnostic, not the final checking model.
title: Compiler2 diagnostics: emit type/no-matching-clause for partial case/with
